_comment: The low-level tool set of run 7 (mist-model-host plan v2), in the OpenAI `tools` format llama-server reads with --jinja. Eleven tools; nothing here is executed: run 7 scores the calls a model makes. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and times 24-hour HH:MM, resolved from the date and time the low-level prompt gives. `hand_off` passes a request up to the larger model.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the timer in seconds.

function.name: set_alarm
function.description: Set an alarm for a date and time.

function.name: cancel_alarm
function.description: Cancel the alarm set for a time.

time.description: Time of the alarm to cancel, 24-hour HH:MM.

function.name: add_reminder
function.description: Add a reminder that is spoken at a date and time.

text.description: What to remind the user of.

function.name: add_to_list
function.description: Add items to one of the user's lists.

function.name: set_lights
function.description: Switch, dim or brighten the lights in a room, or in every room.

room.description: The room, or all for every room.

action.description: What to do; set uses brightness.

function.name: control_music
function.description: Play, pause, skip or change the volume of the music.

query.description: What to play, for play: an artist, a genre, a mood or a playlist.

function.name: show_panel
function.description: Show a panel on one of the desk monitors.

monitor.description: 1 is the main screen, 2 the second monitor, 3 the third.

function.name: close_panel
function.description: Close a panel; with no panel named, close the one in focus.

function.name: sleep
function.description: Go quiet until the user speaks the wake word again.

function.name: hand_off
function.description: Pass the request to the larger model, for anything that needs memory of past conversations or work, a long answer, or careful thought.

request.description: The user's request, restated in full.

reason.description: Why the request is passed up.
